S0.notes: Interior rFFT bins are independent circular complex Gaussians ((re+1j*im)/sqrt(2)*scale); Nyquist bin (even N) is correctly rescaled by sqrt(2) to the full endpoint variance J*fs*N. The DC bin is NOT given the matching sqrt(2) correction: it is assigned variance J*fs*N/2 (the interior-bin formula) instead of the declared endpoint formula J*fs*N used by Nyquist and by the target paper convention (EXP-01). Confirmed empirically (200k-draw flat-PSD Monte Carlo): DC empirical E|X0|^2 ~= 128.2 against an interior-formula prediction of 128.0 and an endpoint-formula prediction of 256.0; Nyquist empirical ~= 255.3 against the endpoint prediction of 256.0. This is a real, previously untested inconsistency in this smaller core generator -- NOT present in the separate 'upgraded modular generator' noise_module/noise_module/NoiseGenerator.py, whose psd_density_to_rfft_power() halves ONLY the interior bins (power[1:upper] *= 0.5), leaving DC and Nyquist both at the full endpoint scale -- i.e. NoiseGenerator.py implements the DC/Nyquist convention correctly; src/noise_geometry/noise/synthetic.py does not. Practical impact on S0/S1/S2/S5 results is negligible (one bin out of 65-129 rFFT bins, and the S1/S2 pulse templates and the S5 sin/cos signal basis carry ~zero DC power), but it is a genuine defect that a rigorous audit must not silently pass over, and it should be fixed under EXP-01 with a regression test added first.
